name: Sparse Voxel Octree Construction (Bottom-Up)
definition: A bottom-up algorithm to construct a Sparse Voxel Octree from surface voxels, using Morton codes for indexing and grouping child nodes to create parent nodes.
summary: This GPU method builds a Sparse Voxel Octree by grouping compacted surface voxels via Morton codes to identify parent-child relationships, differing from top-down or hash-table approaches by explicitly constructing the hierarchy from leaf voxels upwards.
